credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue expanded 14.0% YoY in Sep 2026 to ₹5661.0 cr, aligning with management claims of double-digit top-line growth.
3-year profit CAGR of 5.4% trails 3-year revenue CAGR of 13.8%, contradicting management's margin expansion narrative.
Operating cash flow increased to ₹2422.0 cr in Mar 2026, maintaining strong cash conversion with OCF/PAT at 1.57.

bull: Mar 2026 revenue grew 17.9% YoY to ₹20290.0 cr for full year with ₹2422.0 cr operating cash flow.
Mar 2026 Q4 EBITDA margin hit 15.0%, delivering on Q3 guidance of 14.5%-15.0%.
5-year average cash conversion is robust at 1.47 with D/E ratio low at 0.11 as of Sep 2026.
bear: Profit lagging sales over 3 years (5.4% vs 13.8%), indicating persistent margin compression.
ROCE stands low at 9.24% and ROE at 7.35% for the period.
EBITDA margin remained flat at 14.0% in Jun 2026 and Sep 2026, delaying FY27 expansion targets.
watch: EBITDA margin in H2 FY27 relative to the 50-75 bps full-year expansion target.
Salt and tea volume growth vs raw material inflation discussed in Q2 FY27 analyst calls.
